batting.name: RS Bopara
batting.dismissal: c A Kumble b P Kumar

batting.name: MS Bisla
batting.dismissal: c EJG Morgan b JH Kallis

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c EJG Morgan b DW Steyn

batting.name: MK Pandey
batting.dismissal: c IK Pathan b PP Chawla

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c M Kaif b Bipul Sharma

balls.text: top edges the slog over short third man and Kallis rushes back and makes a really desperate diving stop near the boundary
short in length and outside off, flashed to point and they have reached 200
oopsy! a wide off the fifth ball .. Punjab on 199
walks down the track, fetches the short delivery from outside off and slaps it high to wide long-off boundary.
Bopara is gone after a fine 77. He swung this to front of square-leg where Kumble holds on to it . Three balls left. Can they get past 200?

Dropped by Steyn Bopara had top edged the slog against the slower one and it went high towards third man .. Steyn back-pedaled from short third man and went too far back and the ball fell in front of him! and what's more it bounces past him and goes to the boundary. Kumar looks very pissed. If looks could kill and all that ...
Clubbed! Low full toss and it has been swung away over midwicket boundary. Hop, skip and jump of joy from Preity Zinta
moves outside leg,, yorker gets past the attempted square drive and to Boucher
full and dipping on Bopara who squeezes it to square-leg
Another full toss, third one of the over, and this has disappeared to square-leg boundary. Preity Zinta claps.
goes towards the off stump, Kallis fires it full on the middle and off line, Mahela edges the on drive to his boot
another full toss, around waist high, swung away behind square-leg
OMG! A reverse sweep against Kallis! Mahela reverse sweeps the full toss on the middle stump to third man boundary!
Crashed! Bopara works his bottom-hand over time to lift the really full delivery over midwicket and it races away to the boundary
Slam! This time he moved outside leg stump, went down on his knee to cream this full delivery to cover boundary. Whack!
celebrates his fifty with a paddle sweep ... He moved well outside off, fetched the ball from outside off and paddled it between keeper and short fine-leg
short in length, pulled away to long-on
full delivery around off stump, driven to long-on. 50 up for Ravi Bopara
moves outside off stump, PK slips in a slower one further outside off and BOpara fails to connect with his slog .. called a wide
slower one, beats Mahela's attempted cut but also gets past Boucher
outside off stump, cut away to Kallis at backward point but they rush across for the quick single
shuffles towards off stump and unfurls the sweep shot to perfection
Slows up this one as well, tosses it across... Mahela was down the track, waited that fraction to adjust to the lack of pace and lofted it over long-off
slows this one. pulled away to midwicket
from a round-armish action .. squeezes that out around off stump, . bopara edges his pull shot to the on side
quicker one, shorter in length, pulled  .. one bounce to deep midwicket fielder
floats it just down the leg side. Mahela had moved outside off and couldn't connect with his slog sweep
another short delivery, swatted away to cover
Banged in short again, at the body, Yuvraj goes for that short-arm pull but sends it straight to the fielder at deep square-leg
full delivery around off, pushed out to cover
Another short delivery, Yuvraj is in trouble, takes out the bottom-hand off the handle and manages to stab the ball to fine-leg
fuller, outside off stump, driven to left of sweeper cover for 2 runs
fires it in short, Yuvraj singh plays a short-arm-swat pull to backward square-leg boundary
slower one outside off stump, Bopara is beaten, going for the drive
on the off stump line, pushed out to cover
on drives it to mid-on region
lifting delivery on the middle and leg line, Yuvraj hops to tap it to the on side
run down to third man for a single

It was the slower one and BIsla swings it straight to deep midwicket. He has done his job though. He was in all sorts of trouble against the pace and bounce of Steyn but made merry against the others. Entertaining knock.
fuller, outside off stump, steered wide of third man where Kallis makes a diving save
moves outside leg stump and Steyn bangs it in short ,, Bisla can't connect with his forcing shot .. Bopara gets across to have a chat
slower one, full and around off, dragged off the inner edge
in the channel outside off, Bopara goes for the big square drive but doesn't connect
Forehand cross court! It was a short delivery outside off stump and Bopara flate bats it over wide mid-off
length delivery just outside off stump, run down to third man and Bopara comes back for the second run. Boucher takes out the bails... and Bopara dives to get back in the crease .. just in time
on the middle and off line, tapped past square-leg
short and wide, Bopara cuts it hard to the point boundary
worked to the on side for a single
goes for the big swing and gets an inside edge to fine-leg region

outside off stump, slightly slower, short in length, top edges it in the air but it lands safely around mid-off region .. Vinay picks the ball and fires a throw at the non striker's end. Kohli thinks it would be a direct hit and lets it go .. it misses the stumps with the batsman well short of the crease
almost yorker length ,squeezed out to long-on
moves outside off, tries to paddle scoop it over Boucher but doesn't connect properly .. it goes of Boucher's pads
slightly short in length and pulled away superbly to wide long-on boundary
from round-arm action .. outside off stump ... punched to sweeper cover
released like a seamer .. outside off stump, mistimes it to cover
moves down the track and drags it to deep midwicket
gets forward to stab it to the off side
loud shout for lbw .. turned down by Harper. Two-fingered googly on the middle stump line, hits him on middle and leg.. perhaps missing leg
cuts in from just outside off, punched to the bowler
walks right across to outside off stump and Virat follows him but Bisla manages to scoop it over Boucher!
full and outside off stump, square driven to left of point where Manish makes a diving stop
turns it past square-leg
leans forward to drive to deep cover
around the off stump line, tapped wide of backward point
slower one, on a length on the middle, punched down to long-on
full in length, tilting in late, pushed out towards midwicket ..
slower one, short in length and around leg stump, that length and line allows Bopara to pull it to deep backward square-leg boundary
around off stump, pushed through point
This is imperious! Bislaaaaaaa! Cracker! He sashayed down the track and plays a wonderfully nonchalant lofted drive over long-off
Fabo! Bravo! Bopara, who was hitting down the ground so far, decides to take the aerial route. He moved down the track and deposited this one over long-on!
And again! It was drilled down the track and Kumble bravely puts his right hand out to stop it ...!
leans forward to drive it really hard back down the pitch and Kumble gets his body in the way
stays back to tap this to the on side
loopy delivery on a length outside off, Bisla pushes it through covers to reach his maiden IPL fifty! 50 from just 36 balls.. Cracking start from Punjab
Thrash! Bisla you beauty! He rushed down the track and lifted the ball over long-off!
fine delivery moving away from the off stump, BOpara is beaten, trying to guide it to third man. Super over this from Vinay
shuffles across and shapes to play the paddle shot and Vinay pushes it wider outside off stump.. BOpara tries to run it down to third man  but can't connect
gets forward to drive the length delivery back to Vinay
around the off stump line, guided to backward point
leans forward to work it through the on side
full and straight, eased to short midwicket
leg break turning away from the off stump, forced away to deep cover
gets forward to drive it to long-on
moves down the track and goes for a big hit but is beaten in the flight and drags it off the inner half of the bat past midwicket ...
around the off stump, skids on, pushes it to the cover
really full delivery, mistimes his on drive to right of non-striker and Kumble makes a desperate tumbling save
leans forward to on drive wide of long-on for couple of runs
slower one, fuller, on the middle and leg, turned through midwicket
Whack! Bisla is making merry. He stays back and lifts his front leg and imperiously pulls the short one over wide midwicket!
tapped to the on side
Superb shot this. It was dug in short of length, on the middle stump line, and Bisla, perhaps expecting it, swivelled to pull it over square-leg
bangs it in short of length, kicks up around off, Bisla is late on the forcing shot . flat bats it to mid-off
Six over third man! Bisla, our off-side hero, moves outside leg stump again and slashes the short delivery .. up and over third man.
this one is fuller and outside off and flies past the outside edge . superb over
he is really going after Bisla here. Another short one, into the rib cage this time, stabbed away awkwardly to the on side

Ouch! A nasty bouncer on the m iddle stump line, Bisla tries to duck and get out of the way at the last minute. Too late. The ball kicks up and flies off his helmet  ( I think) over Boucher .. Given as runs .. may be there was some gloves involved .. not sure
full in length straightening outside off stump, edged down to third man
Full and down the leg side

Almost run out jabbed out to the off side ... and Steyn rushes across, picks the ball and flicks the throw but misses the stumps ... Had he hit the stumps,  Bisla, who was diving to get inside the crease, would have been a goner
on the pads, nudged away to the on side
he loves that off side, our Bisla ie. Again, he moves outside leg and cover drives but this time can't pierce the field
slower one, on a length around off stump line, pushed out to cover
sharp bouncer on the middle stump line, Bisla shapes to pull but gets out of the way as the ball flies over his head
in the zone outside off stump and the keeper gathers

Top shot! What a fab hit. He moved outside leg stump, held his balance superbly and punched the short of length delivery over off stump up and over point boundary. Really fabulous hit. It wasn't a horizontal bat shot .. he just lashed it up and over
back of length on the off stump line, pushed out to mid-on
around the off stump line, punched to cover
around the off stump line, shaping away, pushed out to extra cover
around the off stump line, edges the off drive towards mid-on for a single
another bouncer but this one drifts down the leg side
bouncer outside off stump, Bisla allows it to pass him
short in length and outside off stump, Bisla plays a nice crunchy on the up drive to left of cover
Bisla charges out, PK holds his calm and cuts this one from just outside off stump and it bounces over the stumps ...
in the zone outside off stump, moving away late and Bisla is beaten, trying to waft it away to the off side
wide down the leg side ... Boucher makes yet another diving stop
pushes this short of length delivery to the point region

fast pacy lifting deliver into the ribcage .. Bisla is in a awkward position, takes the bottom hand of the handle and fends it off in an ungainly fashion .. the ball is i n the air and just wide of the diving Boucher down on the leg side
pushes this down the leg side ... Boucher dives to gather it
Another one going away from the off stump and Bisla is all at sea. They have a nice word in hindi for this - Aukat!
Almost ... cleaned up .. it cut away late from the leg and middle line, the batsman is almost squared-up and manages to edge it away to backward point
The crowd are screaming RCB as Steyn rushes in to bowl. Lovely delivery, shaping away late, and moves past the defensive prod .. and the keeper collects
hint of away swing but poor fielding from Steyn. It was driven just to the left of him and he allowed it to burst through his fingers ...
loverly outswinger! It moved away sharply and Ravi Bopara was almost fatally attracted to it .. the ball just about missed taking the outside edge
around the off stump line, tilts in this time - he has been taking away mostly so far - pushed back down the pitch
around the off stump line, pushed out to point region
leans forward, gets close to the line of the outswinger and pushes it gently to left of mid-off
lands on a length outside off and veers away sharply, left alone
The 23-year old (seriously?!) Praveen Kumar bowls to Ravi Bopara, Full and swinging away from the off stump line, pushed out to point
Game over! Another cover drive seals the game. What a run fest this was. Crash Bang Wallop.
Whaddaplayaaaaa! Low full toss again and Kallis plays a classy inside-out cover drive
Yet another full toss, dipping around off stump, swung straight to long-on
The full tosses keep coming though and Kohli has slammed this to cover boundary.
This time, it veers further away from LOC .. wide
Ah! it was a low full toss well outside off, Kohli lets it go thinking it will be called a wide but its on that border line of control
SHot! Slightly short in length and outside off, Kallis rocks back to play a feisty cut shot. What an over for RCB, Kallis has surely swung the game their way now or will there be any further twist?
Kallis is thumping Bipul all over the park. THis time he went down on his knee and played the slog sweep to perfection. The white ball has landed amid screaming fans
goes for the slog sweep but doesn't connect properly
Jacques Kallis is showing who is da boss. Again, he sashayed down the track and played a powerful whippy flick over wide midwicket
Imperious. He took a couple of steps down the track and powered it up and over wide long-on. Maximum!
rushes down the track and heaves it to long-on
Fine stop from Kaif this time. It was drilled hard to left of him at long-off and he makes a fine diving stop
full delivery, driven hard but straight to Kaif
taps it to the off side for a s ngle
shorter in length, pulled to long-on
dropped by Kaif at long-off Kohli hammers this full length delivery high towards long-off where Kaif jumps near the boundary and ends up palming the difficult chance over the boundary
moves outside leg stump, Bopara slips in a slower one outside off and Kohli is fooled
gets down the track and drives towards extra cover for a single
around off stump, cut straight to backward point
on the middle and leg, tapped to midwicket
again gives him the charge and drags it to wide long-on region
skips down the track and as the bowler drifts to the pads, Kallis flicks it away to long-leg boundary
moves down the track and drives to left of long-on for couple of runs
really full delivery, Kallis can only drive it straight to long-off
gentle medium pace, full and on the off stump line, driven to cover
slices this full length delivery over backward point. Whiplashed away!
outside off stump, tapped to point .. this time Kohli wants a single but gets back in a hurry
rotates the strike with a drive to long-on
fullish on the leg and middle, pushed to midwicket .. Mahela throws to the bowler who fails to collect it cleanly .. close call for Kallis who had backed up too far

Bipul Sharma has broken through. Robin charged down the track, Sharma shortened the length and Robin skied it up to the off side circle where Kaif settles safely under the ball. What a blistering and entertaining knock this was.
Ah! he goes for the reverse sweep and is struck on the pad outside off. Kallis walks over for a chat.
backs away at  the last minute to cut it very late to the left of short third man where Abdulla does well to get some hand on it ... 50 for Robin Uthappa and he acknowledges the cheers from the crowd
taps it to point for a single.
quickish arm ball, on middle and off, punched to cover
on the middle stump line, worked to midwicket. Moves to 48 from 17 balls.
gets across and on drives to long-on for a single. 25 runs have flooded in that over and the crowd have gone mad.

Sreesanth has no answer to this violence. Full delivery on the leg and middle, Robin eases it to the square-leg boundary. Sreesanth thinks the over has been completed and is walking away. Sorry boy, please to come back. One more left. Next is what?
That's a crowdkiller! Robin has got this crowd going like anything. Full delivery, he clears the front foot and knifes it over wide long-on. Up up and over. What an innings this is turning out to be
The white ball is flying every where in Chinnaswamy stadium. Low full toss and Robin lifts it rather nonchalantly over long-off
gets forward to drive to left of long-off for couple of runs
Thwack! Sreesanth drifts towards the pad and Robin got into a fine position to pull it it to backward square-leg boundary
leans forward to squeeze the slower yorker past the bowler
walks to the off stump line and drills yet another slower one to the straight boundary. Fab hit.
Crash bang wallop. Robin clears the front foot and slams the slower one to the second tier behind long-on!
slower off cutter on the middle and leg, tapped to square-leg
full pitched around off, driven to long-off.
low full toss outside off stump, carved away to deep point region .. he should have put that away..
really full delivery, mistimes the on drive to long-on. 100 up.
quicker one around off, punched to backward point
gets forward to drive to long-off
Awww. skillfully delicious. It was the leg break on the off stump line, Robin backed away at the last minute to play a delectably yummy late cut between backward point and short third man
moves down the track and almost flat-bats the short-of-length delivery to the straight boundary. Brutal hit!
full and straight on the off stump line, driven to sweeper cover
hangs on the back foot to punch it to deep cover
quicker one but drops it short  and Jacques flays it over midwicket with a brutal pull shot
taps it to midwicket for a single
comes in with the arm, punched to cover
on the middle and off line, punched to long-on
gets forward to work it through wide midwicket
quickish slider on middle, punched down to long-on
quicker, shorter, outside off, Kallis flat bats it high over the bowler and falls safely between long-off and long-on
really full, just short of blockhole, dug out back to the bowler
leans forward to work it to deep midwicket
short of length, skids on straight, pushed out to the off side
quick slider, full in length around off, Manish tries to swing it over midwicket and edges a dolly to backward point .
on the off stump line, pushed out to the off side. The camera pans to Vijay Mallya, owner of RCB, who gives a thumbs up sign. But thumbs up is owned by Coke no? Ok sorry for that PJ..
around the off stump line, driven to cover
floats this across and Manish drills it to right of Yuvraj who gets a hand on the stinging shot .. takes some pace off it .. some might say drop but oh boy that was hit powerfully
goes for the quicker one. Mistake. Manish clears the front foot and pulls the short-of-length delivery over wide long-on. Clubbed!
slows up the pace, floats it across, nudged to the on side
around the off stump, forced to left of cover where Bopara makes a fine diving stop
flat, quick around middle and off, forced off the back foot to long-on
quick slider on the middle stump line, eased past square-leg
leans forward to push it to long-off
bounces from short of length on the off stump line, cut away to point
full and o n the middle stump line, driven to long-on
quickish delivery on middle and leg, rolls off the pad to the on side
Bosh! He picked the slower one early, went down on his knee and thrashed it high over long-off boundary. Crowd roar and roar. Deepika Padukone, wearing the RCB jersey, can't stop smiling
angles it across Kallis who runs it down to third man
keeper standing up to the stumps now. Full in length and outside off, squeezed down to third man
shuffles outside off stump and whips the full delivery from off stump to midwicket
Thrilling shot! He sashayed down the track and smoked the length delivery to the screaming fans behind long-on boundary
Edged r to third man boundary. It was a slower one outside off, Manish wanted to heave it over mid-on and got a fat edge
slower off cutter, tapped to the on side
Crunchy Wallop! It was banged in short and Kallis pressed back to pull it high over wide midwicket boundary
slower one, full and around off, driven fluently but straight to cover fielder
What a shot. It was just short of the yorker length outside off stump, Kallis opened his bat-face and steered it superbly to third man boundary
slower one around off stump, pushed to right of mid-off
full in length, lands around off stump and just goes away with the angle. Manish is beaten,driving inside the line
unfurls a flowing cover drive but can't beat the off-side field
lovely leg cutter, opens up Kallis who manages to jab it out to the off side
lands outside off stump, moves away even further .. wide
full and down the leg side ... wide
full in length and outside off stump, shapes away late, Kallis stabs inside the line
lovely delivery , late movement on the off and middle line, squeezed out off the outer edge to cover
short in length and outside off stump, bounces away, Kallis top edges the slog over slips
Super delivery, kicks up from short of length outside off stump .. that one really flew .. past the attempted jab from Kallis and surprised Sanga who lets it go past him
length delivery outside off stump, run down to third man
slower one, full and outside off, mistimes to mid-off
slower on the off stump line, mistimes to the off side
works this one to the on side .. Manish changing his bat
Whack! The umpire has been almost decapitated. It was a length delivery around the off stump and Manish blasts it past the startled bowler
pushes this to the off side
Stunner! Classy! It was a full delivery with a bit on inswiing, on the off stump line, Kallis leaned forward to lift it gorgeously to wide long-off boundary
lovely outswinger . Manish pushes inside the line and is beaten. Both Sanga and Sreesanth smile
Kallis pushes towards mid-off and rushes for a quick single but Yuvraj fails to hit the stumps . Had he hit, Kallis would have been out
hurls it fuller, gets some away swing, Manish covers for movement and drives to right of mid-on for a single
cutting away from the off stump line, Manish tries to cut but gets nowhere close to the ball
short in length, cuts it away for a single
length delivery moving away from the off stump, left alone
really full delivery on the middle stump line, pushed to mid-on
short in length, on the middle stump line, wristed to fine-leg boundary. A good delivery actually, it curved in but Kallis used the angle to work it away
full and in the zone outside off, Kallis is beaten, going for the big expansive cover drive
curves towards off and middle line, pushed out to the off side
on a length on the off and middle line, pushed out wide of mid-on
on the middle stump line, straightening, worked to midwicket
short in length and outside off, cut away to point
